name: Denpa no Dorei
source:
Kazuma works at a TV company. One day, he gets a special power by chance. He can now emit radio waves and people who receive them follow his orders. He doesn't know why, but he enjoys a life full of sex using it. A while later, he hears a rumor that girls often get involved in rape cases. He knows it's not him, so who's behind it?

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081201133539/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1009070]ErogeShop[/url]]
